title: Tesla Is Killing the Cybertruck. Here's What Went Wrong #shorts

scenes.text: Over a million people reserved Tesla's Cybertruck. Now Tesla is ending production.
The plan: a starting price under forty thousand dollars, and about two hundred fifty thousand trucks a year.
Reality? About thirty-nine thousand sold in America in 2024. Just twenty thousand in 2025.
On November sixth, Elon Musk said the Texas line will wind down, to make room for the Cybercab robotaxi. The last trucks: around late summer 2027.
And the cheapest one you can still order? The Cyberbeast, at almost a hundred and ten thousand dollars.
Musk still calls it Tesla's best vehicle ever. Failure, or ahead of its time? Tell me below. Follow EV Drive.
